text: Kestrel adopted an event log and became its own repository at /data/kestrel (git init, branch main), moved out of supply-chain-pomdp/supplychain on the author's decision so it never merges with the research benchmark. Origin: built 2026-09-15 by spec-driven subagent development; spec and plans under docs/superpowers/; per-task review ledger stayed in the old repo at .superpowers/sdd/2026-09-15-kestrel-world/ (git-ignored there).

State at repo creation: 188 tests passed in 88.90s; 5 Luna task runs + 5 rule baselines complete (docs/model-findings.md, 15 failures, 4 defects fixed); artifacts/kestrel-demo.html 14.15 MB; Docker image kestrel 310 MB verified (API, desk page, rule CLI). Key now read from OPENROUTER_API_KEY or ./.env.

First commit fa799e8 pushed to private repo https://github.com/debsagar/kestrel (main): 73 files, 12004 insertions. Process docs (spec, plans, screenshots, artifact schema, AGENTS.md) moved out to the old repo's SDD archive; curated model transcripts flattened to transcripts/<task>-luna.jsonl; runs/ ignored.

Demo usability: play speed 700 ms -> selectable 4000/2000/800 ms (default 2000), previous/next day buttons, day controls moved under the header, About and Findings are native dialogs with a Back button and Escape; base font 14 -> 15 px; Findings tab now embeds docs/findings-summary.html instead of the raw 800-line markdown. Verified headless Chromium: no console errors. Suite 188 passed. Artifact republished (Version 3).
